tools.api_key_gan_voi_ghe: <API key bound to the agent seat>
tools.may_chu_mcp_tool_company: MCP server {p0} · {p1} company_* tools · permissions by seat tier
tools.agent_khong_co_dong_quyen: An agent with no permission row is denied (default deny)
tools.thu_tu_ap_dung_ngoai: Precedence: member exception → seat tier → default. "Ask" creates an approval

secrets.gan_vao_sandbox_duoi_dang: Mounted into the sandbox as a temporary file
secrets.chi_danh_tinh_co_quyen: Only identities with a grant (people, agents, sandbox profiles, environments)
secrets.dang_ky_tham_chieu_dau: Register the first reference in the form above.
secrets.gan_voi_nguoi_agent_ho: Bound to people, agents, sandbox profiles or deployment environments

onboarding.kiem_tra_dich_vu_api: Check that the API service is running.
onboarding.ten_hien_tren_menu_so: The name appears in the menu, org chart and reports. You can change it later.
onboarding.moi_mau_dung_san_phong: Each template sets up departments, agent department heads and a reporting chart. Add or remove people later in Team.
onboarding.da_dung_phong_agent_co: Built “{p0}”: {p1} departments, {p2}/{p3} agents on the gateway.
onboarding.kiem_tra_gateway_model_va: Check the gateway, models and agents so the team can work.
onboarding.co_the_di_tiep_cong: You can continue: the company and goal are still created, but agents only run once the gateway is OK. Fix it later in Settings › OpenClaw.
onboarding.nina_la_tro_ly_dieu: Nina is the executive assistant: you give the outcome you want, Nina breaks it into department plans and sends them for your approval.
onboarding.vd_50_don_dau_tien: e.g. First 50 orders in 2 weeks, a post every day…
onboarding.chi_phi_model_toi_da: Maximum model cost — hitting a level asks you first
onboarding.ke_hoach_se_hien_o: The plan will show in Goals & Plans for your approval. Approvals also appear in the Inbox.

auth.kiem_tra_lai_hoac_nho: Check again, or ask your administrator to send a new invitation.
auth.vao_cong_ty_cua_anh: Enter your company and the agent team at work.
auth.cua_so_sang_la_agent: A lit window is an agent at work.

invite.mat_khau_can_it_nhat: Password must be at least 8 characters.
invite.hai_lan_nhap_mat_khau: The two passwords don't match — re-enter the second one.
invite.link_moi_hong_hoac_het: If the link is broken or expired, ask the inviter for a new one.
invite.link_moi_chi_dung_mot: Invitation links work once and expire after 7 days.
invite.vao_la_thay_ngay_so: Once in, you'll see the team chart — people and agents in one company.
